For sale, a family estate in Valjevska Loznica, near Valjevo. The estate includes 3 hectares (30,000m2) of fertile land, a forest, established plum orchards, as well as a residential building of 180 m² with an additional 100 m² of auxiliary buildings (including a barbecue house).
The house has 4 bedrooms, one bathroom, and secured parking for four vehicles. The estate borders a rural stream and has its own well, and city water supply, lighting, and good road connectivity are available. It is just a few minutes from the main road and local railway, 7–8 minutes drive from the center of Valjevo, and about 30 minutes from Beograd. The location is peaceful, surrounded by nature, near several spas (Vrujci), ideal for living, vacation, or the development of rural tourism. Exchange possible for Cg, the coast, and Pg.
